newsitem.title: USA: Zions to buy GB Bancorp unit, take charge.
newsitem.headline: Zions to buy GB Bancorp unit, take charge.

text.p: Zions Bancorp said Monday it had signed a definitive agreement with GB Bancorp to acquire unit of GB called Grossmont Bank in a stock deal worth about $173 million.
Zions said in a statement it will issue 4.7 million shares of common stock to Grossmont shareholders for the remaining 95.5 percent of the bank that it does not already own.
It said the transactions will be immediately accretive to earnings, and will bring about $2 million in charges in the fourth quarter.
The value of the deal, based on the July 7 closing price of Zions share at $36-3/8 each, is 3.3 times Grossmont's book value, or about 16.8 times its estimated 1997 earnings, it added.
Zions, which has owned about 4.5 percent of Grossmont since October 1995, said it expected the deal to close in the fourth quarter.
Based in San Diego, California, Grossmont Bank has about $720 million in assets, it said.
With assets of $7.2 billion, Zions Bancorp operates banking offices in Utah, Arizona, Nevada and Colorado.
